title: Technology Trends Outlook 2025
notes: 108-page report, 'Fifth edition', 13 numbered trends in three groups. Equity investment (2024) and job-postings change (2023–24) per trend in notes. Adoption score graphical only, not recorded. rank = printed trend number; forecast entries carry their trend's rank.

entries.label: Agentic AI
entries.quote: Agentic AI is an artificial intelligence system capable of independently planning and executing complex, multistep tasks.
entries.subject: Agentic AI
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $1.1 billion; job postings 2023–24: +985%. New trend in 2025.

entries.label: Artificial intelligence
entries.quote: Artificial intelligence refers to computer systems designed to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.
entries.subject: Artificial intelligence
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $124.3 billion; job postings 2023–24: +35%. Per the report, an overarching artificial intelligence category replaces applied AI, generative AI, industrializing machine learning, and next-generation software development (2024 trends).

entries.label: Artificial intelligence
entries.quote: Gartner projects that by 2027, 40 percent of gen AI solutions will be multimodal, up from just 1 percent in 2023.
entries.subject: Multimodal generative AI
entries.metric: share of gen AI solutions that are multimodal
entries.note: Attributed in the text to Gartner.

entries.label: Artificial intelligence
entries.quote: Google parent Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are each projected to spend $70 billion to more than $100 billion on AI-related capital expenditures in 2025
entries.subject: Hyperscaler AI capital expenditure
entries.note: Footnote cites CNBC and Reuters.

entries.label: Application-specific semiconductors
entries.quote: Application-specific semiconductors are purpose-built chips optimized to perform specialized tasks.
entries.subject: Application-specific semiconductors
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $7.5 billion; job postings 2023–24: +22%. New trend in 2025.

entries.label: Application-specific semiconductors
entries.quote: McKinsey analysis suggests that, in a midrange scenario, demand for AI-ready data center capacity will rise at an average rate of 33 percent a year between 2023 and 2030.
entries.subject: AI data center capacity demand
entries.metric: annual growth of demand for AI-ready data center capacity
entries.note: Midrange scenario.

entries.label: Application-specific semiconductors
entries.quote: This means that about 70 percent of total demand for data center capacity will be for data centers equipped to host workloads from AI systems by 2030.
entries.subject: AI share of data center demand
entries.metric: share of data center capacity demand that is AI-ready
entries.note: Midrange scenario (previous sentence).

entries.label: Application-specific semiconductors
entries.quote: A global shortage of skilled semiconductor workers that could lead to a significant shortfall by 2030 is delaying production and threatening supply chain stability.
entries.subject: Semiconductor talent shortage

entries.label: Advanced connectivity
entries.quote: Advanced connectivity has continued to grow across interest and innovation metrics from 2023 to 2024 and is a leader among the trends for number of patents granted.
entries.subject: Advanced connectivity
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $44.2 billion; job postings 2023–24: –14%. Quote from 'Scoring the trend'; the definition sentence was not cleanly extractable.

entries.label: Advanced connectivity
entries.quote: The global network-slicing market, which provides specific performance characteristics across each slice of a network, is projected to reach $1.69 billion in 2025, an increase of 49.6 percent compared with $1.13 billion in 2024.
entries.subject: Network slicing market

entries.label: Advanced connectivity
entries.quote: Market size is projected to increase from $6.27 billion in 2024 to $32.86 billion by 2032, a CAGR of 23 percent.
entries.subject: Private wireless network market
entries.note: The sentence does not name the market; surrounding text is about private wireless/private 5G networks.

entries.label: Advanced connectivity
entries.quote: North America is at the forefront, with 77 percent population coverage and an expected 89 percent adoption rate by 2030
entries.subject: 5G adoption in North America

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: Cloud and edge computing involve distributing workloads across locations, from hyperscale remote data centers to regional hubs and local nodes.
entries.subject: Cloud and edge computing
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $80.8 billion; job postings 2023–24: +2%.

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: hyperscale data center capacity is projected to triple by 2030
entries.subject: Hyperscale data center capacity

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: McKinsey analysis suggests that global demand for data center capacity could rise 19 to 22 percent annually from 2023 to 2030, more than tripling current demand and reaching 171 to 219 gigawatts a year.
entries.subject: Data center capacity demand

entries.label: Immersive-reality technologies
entries.quote: Immersive-reality technologies encompass augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) and include AR smart glasses, advanced haptic feedback, and AI-powered enhancements that improve rendering, tracking, and processing capabilities.
entries.subject: Immersive reality (AR/VR/MR)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $6 billion; job postings 2023–24: –11%.

entries.label: Immersive-reality technologies
entries.quote: The AR/VR market saw steady but modest growth in 2024, with headset shipments increasing by 10 percent, though forecasts suggest growth may slow in 2025.
entries.subject: AR/VR headset market
entries.note: Footnote cites Neowin.

entries.label: Digital trust and cybersecurity
entries.quote: Digital trust and cybersecurity covers technologies and practices designed to ensure secure, transparent, and trustworthy digital interactions.
entries.subject: Digital trust and cybersecurity
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $77.8 billion; job postings 2023–24: +7%.

entries.label: Quantum technologies
entries.quote: Quantum-based technologies make use of the unique properties of quantum mechanics to execute certain complex calculations exponentially faster than classical computers
entries.subject: Quantum technologies
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $2 billion; job postings 2023–24: –15%.

entries.label: Future of robotics
entries.quote: The future of robotics covers the advancement of robotics capable of performing tasks autonomously or semiautonomously
entries.subject: Robotics
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $7 billion; job postings 2023–24: –2%.

entries.label: Future of robotics
entries.quote: The market opportunity is massive—up to approximately $900 billion by 2040
entries.subject: AI-driven robotics market
entries.note: From a quoted statement by a McKinsey partner printed in the edition (person not named here).

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: Mobility technologies include autonomous vehicles, electric vehicles, drones, urban air mobility solutions, such as electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, and micromobility
entries.subject: Mobility (autonomous, connected, electric, shared)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $131.6 billion; job postings 2023–24: +6%.

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: Unit costs are expected to lower significantly by 2035, as companies achieve greater vehicle utilization, make operational improvements, and reduce R&D needs.
entries.subject: Autonomous vehicle unit costs
entries.note: Context: autonomous-vehicle adoption timeline slipped by two to three years.

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: Delivery drone services are expected to reach $29 billion by 2034, a CAGR of 40 percent.
entries.subject: Drone delivery market
entries.note: Footnote cites Polaris Market Research.

entries.label: Future of bioengineering
entries.quote: Bioengineering is the application of engineering principles to biology, utilizing technological advancements (for example, gene editing, synthetic biology) to improve health and human performance, transform food value chains, and create innovative offerings.
entries.subject: Bioengineering
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $57.3 billion; job postings 2023–24: –17%.

entries.label: Future of space technologies
entries.quote: Space technologies cover satellite systems, launch vehicles, habitation modules, and exploration missions
entries.subject: Space technologies
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $9.3 billion; job postings 2023–24: –9%.

entries.label: Future of energy and sustainability technologies
entries.quote: Energy and sustainability technologies encompass a broad spectrum of innovations aimed at transforming the global energy landscape toward a more sustainable and resilient future.
entries.subject: Energy and sustainability technologies
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2024: $223.2 billion; job postings 2023–24: –6%. Merges 2024's electrification and renewables and climate technologies beyond electrification and renewables.

entries.label: Future of energy and sustainability technologies
entries.quote: Depending on decarbonization pathways, policy support, and the pace of technological progress, nuclear power could account for anywhere from 8 to 43 percent of global electricity by 2040
entries.subject: Nuclear power share
entries.note: Same sentence: market revenues potentially reaching $400 billion under the most optimistic scenarios.

entries.label: Future of energy and sustainability technologies
entries.quote: India is scaling its production capacity and is expected to become the second-largest solar PV manufacturer by 2026.
entries.subject: Solar PV manufacturing in India
entries.metric: India's rank among solar PV manufacturers
